# Quadratic

> Quadratic is an AI-powered spreadsheet platform that combines Python, SQL, and JavaScript for advanced data analysis, visualization, and automation.

Quadratic enables teams to perform complex data analytics, build interactive dashboards, and automate workflows using multiple programming languages within a collaborative spreadsheet interface. It integrates with popular data sources like PostgreSQL, Google Analytics, and Mixpanel, serving business intelligence, product management, sales, and marketing use cases.

## Key Topics

- AI Spreadsheet
- Python Integration
- SQL Queries
- Data Visualization
- JavaScript Support
- Dashboard Builder
- Data Analysis
- API Integration
- Automation & Scheduled Tasks
- Multi-language Support
- Business Intelligence
- Team Collaboration
- Enterprise Security
- PDF Data Import
- Analytics Connections

## Core Platform

- [Quadratic: The AI Spreadsheet](https://www.quadratichq.com): Quadratic AI spreadsheet for data analysis with Python, SQL integration
- [Quadratic: The Python Spreadsheet](https://www.quadratichq.com/python): Native Python code cells with APIs, charts, and SQL support
- [SQL Spreadsheet: Run Queries and Analyze Data | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/sql-client): SQL client for databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake
- [The JavaScript Spreadsheet | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/javascript): JavaScript spreadsheet with native code execution and charting
- [Spreadsheet Formulas: Modern Formula Experience in Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/formulas): AI-assisted formulas with Python, SQL, and JavaScript support

## AI Features & Analytics

- [AI Analysis: Powerful Analytics with Spreadsheet AI | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/ai/analysis): AI-driven analytics with Python, SQL, and real-time visualization
- [AI Chart Generator | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/ai/charts): AI chart generator for data visualization in spreadsheet interface
- [Import Data from PDFs with AI | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/ai/pdf-import): AI-powered PDF data extraction and import into spreadsheets
- [AI Research | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/ai/research): AI research assistant for dataset generation and analysis
- [Scheduled Tasks: Automate Spreadsheet Updates | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/ai/scheduled-tasks): Automated spreadsheet updates and data refresh from APIs/databases

## Data Connections & Integrations

- [PostgreSQL Data Analytics | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/connections/postgresql-db): PostgreSQL integration for data analysis and visualization
- [Google Analytics Spreadsheet | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/connections/google-analytics): GA4 integration for analytics dashboards and automated reporting
- [Mixpanel Data Analytics | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/connections/mixpanel): Mixpanel integration for product analytics and dashboard building
- [Plaid Personal Finance Analytics | Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/connections/plaid): Plaid integration for personal finance tracking and dashboards
